newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Acer plans US$102 mln GRDs.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Acer plans US$102 mln GRDs.

text.p: Taiwan's computer giant Acer Inc said on Thursday it plans to issue global depositary receipts (GDRs) abroad later this year to raise some US$102 million for overseas expansion.
The firm's shareholders' meeting on Wednesday approved a proposal to issue 50 million new shares in a rights issue for the GDR issue, a company spokeswoman said by telephone.
The funds will be used for its overseas expansion in the Philippines, Mexico and the United States, she said.
The shareholders' meeting also passed the proposed T$2.5 stock dividend per share for 1996, she said.
The meeting agreed that Acer can raise its investment ceiling in mainland China to US$25 million from US$5 million, she said.
